name: Brocade
description: Raised metal thread: a small figure lifted off the ground, catching a shadow on one side.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 20%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50.0% 0.0%, 62.0% 38.0%, 100.0% 50.0%, 62.0% 62.0%, 50.0% 100.0%, 38.0% 62.0%, 0.0% 50.0%, 38.0% 38.0%); clip-path: polygon(50.0% 0.0%, 62.0% 38.0%, 100.0% 50.0%, 62.0% 62.0%, 50.0% 100.0%, 38.0% 62.0%, 0.0% 50.0%, 38.0% 38.0%); ${shadow} -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 6%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 100.0%, 0.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 0.0%, 50.0% 12.0%, 12.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 88.0%, 88.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 12.0%); clip-path: polygon(50.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 100.0%, 0.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 0.0%, 50.0% 12.0%, 12.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 88.0%, 88.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 12.0%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
